title: Kovai Brothers
desc: Ganesh is distraught when his niece is killed and sets out to seek revenge with the help of his friend Vasanth. They decide to start working at a television channel to complete their mission.

title: Adharmam
desc: Dharma is a sandalwood smuggler who plants a sapling for every tree he chops. After his death, his brother Arjuna handles the business and asserts that the state is responsible for the rise in crime.

title: Kaadhal Desam
desc: Two boys from rival colleges become good friends after an incident. However, neither of them realise that they have both fallen in love with the new girl, Divya.

title: Karuppu Roja
desc: After falling in love, Vinodh manipulates Tulasi into marriage. However, once their first child is born, he kidnaps the infant, intending to sacrifice him to Satan in a bid to cure his mother.

title: Vallavanukku Pullum Aayudham
desc: Sakthi befriends Vaanathi while travelling to his village to sell his ancestor's property. Little does he know that her father has been waiting for him to seek revenge for more than two decades.
